purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Jehanabad

queries.query: Jehanabad Bihar official cadastral parcel map land records GIS Bhunaksha
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Government of Bihar BhuNaksha cadastral viewer, BiharBhumi revenue portal, the Directorate of Land Records & Survey service page, and the official Jehanabad district map/revenue pages. The live BhuNaksha viewer exposes district, sub-division, circle and mauza selectors and anonymous REST endpoints.

queries.query: जहानाबाद बिहार सरकारी भू नक्शा खतौनी भूमि अभिलेख
queries.result: Hindi first-party discovery identified the official Jehanabad district Revenue and Land Reforms page, which links BiharBhumi, and the BiharBhumi portal's Hindi land-record/map services. The official BhuNaksha selector returned the Hindi Jehanabad mauza label जहानाबाद for the selected administrative path.

registryEvidence.custodian: Directorate of Land Records & Survey / Revenue and Land Reforms Department, Government of Bihar; Jehanabad district administration
registryEvidence.scope: The official Jehanabad district revenue page identifies the state land-record service, and the Government of Bihar BhuNaksha viewer exposes Jehanabad district and locality selectors. This evidences a local/state cadastral map custodian, not open citywide parcel completeness.

Returned mauza code 0063 with English label Jehanabad and Hindi label जहानाबाद; returned survey type Special Survey, map instances First Map and Boundary Verified Map.
Current viewer HTML and linked index.js/config.js retrieved; JavaScript identifies getVVVVExtentGeoref, getPlotAtXY, WMS, and plot-info routes. No credentials or login used.
No map extent response for the selected special-survey map instance; no parcel geometry or ID retained.
Returned the site's generic error page rather than WMS capabilities; no CRS or vector schema inferred.
Direct unauthenticated fetch returned generic error page outside the viewer's expected AJAX flow; not treated as parcel absence.
